stemMd: Every map in the locked cabinet is either a nautical chart or a railway map, but none is both. All railway maps in the cabinet are dated. One undated map is in the cabinet. Which must be true?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The cabinet contains a railway map.

options.label: C
options.textMd: No dated map is a nautical chart.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The undated map is a nautical chart.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Every map outside the cabinet is dated.

explanationMd: Because all railway maps in the cabinet are dated, the undated map cannot be a railway map. The exhaustive either-or classification therefore places it among nautical charts.

distractorRationale.e: The rules concern only the cabinet.
distractorRationale.b: Only one undated map is established.
distractorRationale.c: Charts are not excluded from being dated.
distractorRationale.a: A category allowed by the rule need not have a member.
